_readme: Ten scripted SYNTHETIC patient journeys for the Aster demo. All people are fictitious. Every step names the GNU Health model it should create or change, so a loader or a tester can verify it. Prices are intentionally absent; any amounts must be invented and labelled illustrative. Tags: S = published by Aster, I = standard practice (not published), GAP = not native in GNU Health.

journeys.title: OPD cardiology consult, self-pay, with video follow-up

steps.action: Books via app or phone
Creates UHID, captures ID proof
Vitals and complaint (chest discomfort on exertion)
Consult, diagnosis (stable angina, ICD-10 I20.8), orders ECG and lipid profile
Lipid profile resulted
Prescription
Invoice: consult + ECG + lab; paid by card
Books video follow-up in 4 weeks

journeys.expected: One paid invoice; one evaluation with ICD-10; two orders resulted; follow-up appointment exists.
journeys.calibrates_to: OPD volume (about 12 OPD visits per admission)

journeys.title: Emergency chest pain to cath lab, ICU and cashless discharge

steps.action: Arrival by ambulance, red-priority chest pain, ECG within minutes
Rapid Access Chest Pain pathway: troponin, diagnosis STEMI (I21.x), activates cath lab
Cashless pre-authorisation sent; authority letter received
steps.record: gnuhealth.insurance (policy); pre-auth status: GAP (note on registration)

steps.action: Primary PCI with stent
Admit to CCU, then step-down to ward
steps.record: gnuhealth.inpatient.registration (bed in CCU ward) then bed transfer

steps.action: Advises discharge on day 3
Final bill and summary to TPA; clearance; patient pays non-covered items
steps.record: account.invoice (party: insurer) + account.invoice (party: patient for non-covered); TPA clearance tracking: GAP

gaps: TPA pre-authorisation, authority-letter amount and claim status are not native
journeys.expected: Discharge within 2-6 hours of consultant advice (published range); two invoices; CCU bed released.
journeys.calibrates_to: ED to admission pathway; discharge timing 2-6 hours; payor TPA 30%

journeys.title: Planned robotic knee replacement with TPA pre-authorisation

steps.action: OPD consult advises robotic total knee replacement
Explains room tariff, gives estimate
steps.record: estimate documented (note); no native estimate model: GAP

steps.action: Pre-authorisation and guarantee-of-payment letter
Admit day before surgery, minimal advance, semi-private room
Surgery in OT; implant consumables billed
Post-op care, physiotherapy
steps.record: gnuhealth.patient.evaluation (rounds); nursing charts if module installed

steps.action: Discharge on day 4 with medicines and follow-up
Final bill to TPA

journeys.expected: Length of stay about 4 days for an elective joint case (group mean is 3.2); implants appear as invoice lines.
journeys.calibrates_to: Orthopaedics 7% of revenue; robotic surgery volumes

journeys.title: Maternity: antenatal visits, caesarean delivery, newborn observation

steps.action: Antenatal visits with scans and labs
Admitted in labour; corporate letter on file
Lower-segment caesarean section
Newborn assessed; routine care; vaccination at birth
Discharge day 3 with postnatal advice
Corporate credit invoice

gaps: Newborn registration linked to mother is a convention, not enforced
journeys.expected: Two patients created (mother, baby); pregnancy outcome recorded; corporate invoice outstanding until paid.
journeys.calibrates_to: Women's health 6%, child and adolescent 6%; corporate payor 2%

journeys.title: Oncology day-care chemotherapy cycles, central government scheme

steps.action: Plan: six 3-weekly cycles; scheme referral on file
Package approval documents
Each cycle: pre-chemo labs, drug administration in day-care chair
steps.record: gnuhealth.patient.lab.test; gnuhealth.prescription.order; day-care ward bed (short stay registration)

steps.action: Scheme package-rate invoice per cycle

journeys.expected: Six short-stay registrations, same-day discharge; lower average invoice than self-pay.
journeys.calibrates_to: Oncology 10%; day care about 12.5% of beds (Medcity); ESI/ECHS/CGHS 3%

journeys.title: International patient: cardiac surgery package

steps.action: Enquiry with reports; experts review; treatment plan and cost estimate sent
Medical visa letter; airport pickup arranged; FRRO registration within 14 days
steps.record: visa and FRRO dates as notes: GAP

steps.action: Work-up in OPD, then CABG
Advance, package invoice in foreign currency, receipts
Discharge, return travel, video follow-up booked

gaps: Visa, FRRO and estimate tracking; foreign-currency invoicing needs configuration
journeys.expected: MVT invoice flagged separately from domestic classes; follow-up appointment booked.

journeys.title: Corporate health-check camp (30 employees)

patient.name: Batch of 30 synthetic employees of 'Northwind Logistics (synthetic)'

steps.action: Contract and schedule
Bulk registration of employees
Package tests: blood panel, ECG, chest X-ray
Report review and advice
One monthly corporate invoice
steps.record: account.invoice (party: corporate) with package product lines

journeys.expected: 30 patients, 90 orders resulted, one corporate invoice.

journeys.title: Home sample collection, lab report in app, tele-consult

steps.action: Books home collection in the app
Collects sample at home; accessioned at lab
Analysis and validation; PDF report available in app
Video consultation reviewing results
Online payment

journeys.expected: Report released only after validation; video consult recorded.
journeys.calibrates_to: Aster Labs (232 labs and PECs) and tele-consultation

journeys.title: Recurring dialysis (thrice weekly), state scheme

steps.action: Dialysis plan: 3 sessions per week
Each session in a dialysis chair; monthly labs
Scheme-rate invoice per session or per month

gaps: Recurring session scheduling is a convention (appointments series)
journeys.expected: About 13 sessions a month recorded and billed at the scheme rate.
journeys.calibrates_to: Nephrology 7%; subsidised dialysis in Kerala; state schemes 2%

journeys.title: Preterm newborn in NICU with insurer enhancement

steps.action: Admit preterm baby to NICU
Pre-authorisation, then enhancement as stay extends to 9 days
Daily evaluations, labs, medications
Discharge with follow-up
Final bill to TPA; part disallowance follow-up

journeys.expected: Long-stay outlier (9 days) that lifts the distribution tail above the 3.1-day mean.
journeys.calibrates_to: ALOS distribution tail; NICU share of beds
